items.title: Crypto stocks hold as Clarity Act stalls in Senate
items.summary: Yahoo Finance Senior Business Reporter Ines Ferre discusses the Clarity Act vote, which failed to advance in the Senate, and why crypto stocks remain resilient heading into a historically strong fourth quarter. Robinhood (HOOD) chief investment officer Stephanie Guild explains why she supports regulation such as the Clarity Act, which could provide a clearer framework for institutions and expand retail investors’ access to crypto.

items.title: Why investors should start hedging portfolios if Fed hikes
items.summary: Yahoo Finance Executive Editor Brian Sozzi welcomes Senior Business Reporter Ines Ferre to the Opening Bid to discuss whether the latest Fed rate decision could mark the start of a tightening cycle, which has historically pressured markets. Robinhood (HOOD) chief investment officer Stephanie Guild also weighs in on what higher rates could mean for markets, with a focus on the energy sector.

items.title: The Next Phase of Webull Could Be the One That Matters Most
items.summary: Webull just posted a record trading quarter, eliminated a regulatory headwind it called its defining moment, and closed a major international acquisition, yet the stock is down 34% over the past year. Whether the next phase of its story corrects that or deepens it depends on a few things falling into place.

items.title: The Clarity Act Fails. Could It Be Time to Buy Crypto Stocks?
items.summary: Bitcoin  and other cryptocurrencies fell Wednesday after the Clarity Act, a key crypto regulation bill, failed in the Senate on Tuesday, but Wall Street doesn’t view this as a fatal blow to crypto-related stocks.  The Clarity Act has been one of the crypto industry’s top legislative priorities, and executives had been pushing for the bill to become law this year.  With the bill failing to advance out of the Senate, the question for investors now is what it means for the future of cryptocurrency-related stocks.

items.title: Crypto Stocks Rise Despite Failed Clarity Act Vote: Coinbase, Strategy, and Robinhood Tick Up
items.summary: The Senate killed the crypto bill the industry spent years and hundreds of millions chasing, yet Coinbase, Strategy, and Robinhood are all ticking higher this morning. The reason why reframes everything investors thought Tuesday's selloff meant.

items.title: Will Sports Betting Hurdles Slow Robinhood's Prediction Markets Push?
items.summary: HOOD's prediction markets are surging, but Connecticut and Michigan restrictions could raise costs and slow sports-led growth.

items.title: HOOD Stock Extends Slide Overnight: Ex-Employees Face Crypto Insider Trading Charges
items.summary: Engineers Hefu Chai and Huaisong Xiang allegedly purchased perpetual futures tokens on Hyperliquid between 2025 and 2026 ahead of the company’s public announcements that the underlying cryptocurrency tokens would be listed on Robinhood Crypto.

items.title: Bitcoin Slides, Crypto Stocks Decline As Trump-Backed CLARITY Act Fails To Pass Senate Vote
items.summary: Bitcoin and crypto-related stocks fell sharply on Tuesday after the Senate failed to advance the CLARITY Act.
